title: QuoVadis
overview:
Why must best friends fight each other...

Includes over 70 minutes of narration in total by a lavish cast of voice actors including Hikaru Midorikawa, Mariko Kouda, Hekiru Shiina and Michiko Neya!! Uses 2D animation & 3D CG to stage realistic battle scenes!! Includes cinema-size animation made with the latest digital movie technology!!

QuoVadis is a science fiction strategy RPG with character designs by Haruhiko Mikimoto. A century after a treaty brought peace to the galaxy, young Hal Balanchine trains at an officers' academy, hoping to serve the alliance that keeps that peace - until events set friends against one another. Story scenes alternate with turn-based fleet battles on an isometric map, where you command up to eight starships of different types, guard your flagship, choose formations, and trade beam and missile fire as Hal rises from ship captain toward the top of the fleet.

- Fleets move at the same time on the battle map, so maneuvering against the enemy matters
- Intermissions packed with information to plan your next move
- Memory backup save

なぜ、親友同士が戦わなければならないのか……

緑川光、國府田マリ子、椎名へきる、根谷美智子など、豪華声優陣による合計70分以上のナレーションを収録!!
リアルな戦闘シーンを演じる、2Dアニメーション＆3D･CGを採用!!
最新技術のデジタルムービーを駆使した、シネマサイズのアニメーションを収録!!
